title: Transform
description: A relationship artifact showing how one knowledge artifact becomes, relates to, or connects to another.

id.description: Globally unique slug identifier using lowercase kebab-case.

title.description: A descriptive name for this relationship.

source_type.description: Knowledge type of the source artifact.

target_type.description: Knowledge type of the target artifact.

relationship.description: The nature of the relationship from source to target.

created.description: ISO 8601 date when this transform was recorded.

created_by.description: GitHub username of the contributor who recorded this transform.

rationale.description: Brief explanation of why this relationship exists.

tags.description: Free-form labels for discovery and filtering.
